decisions.name: Golden Blades Women's Hockey League
decisions.reason: Official league description resolves the apparent venue split: this is one league with four divisions, not separate venue operators. Keep one programme identity and map divisions to their venues. Publication remains unapproved.
decisions.programmeScope: One adult women's league: Tier 1, Tier 2A and Tier 2B use Scotiabank Pond in Toronto on Fridays and Sundays; Masters (40+) uses Westwood Arena in Etobicoke on Sundays. The general season runs mid-September to early April. The page describes players over 18. No specific season year, current fee or registration availability is approved by this review. Division and venue details are editorial scope notes, not yet public season offerings.
